summary: Excellent implementation. YAML workflow follows GitHub Actions conventions (pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, reproducible env vars). TypeScript is explicitly typed throughout with proper error handling; each module has single responsibility. Bash is idempotent and error-aware. Test harness comprehensively exercises via act with exact output assertions. Minor: Bun installed twice (once per job) unavoidable in GitHub Actions; not a code issue. Code is shippable.
